title: OpenClaw Second Brain: Turn Your Agent Into a Memory System
summary: Learn how to set up OpenClaw as a second brain with Obsidian integration — persistent memory, daily capture, and searchable knowledge that grows as you work.
body_markdown: The Local REST API only works when Obsidian is open. If it's closed, the API call fails and the agent logs the failure but does not lose the note — it queues it in SOUL.md context. To avoid this entirely, run Obsidian as a background process on startup (Mac: add to Login Items; Windows: add to Task Scheduler). Alternatively, use Blink Claw managed hosting with a cloud sync tool so the vault is always accessible.
